briefdescription.para: Definition of the basic parser string type.

memberdef.name: MUP_ASSERT
memberdef.initializer: if (!(COND)) \ { \ stringstream_type ss; \ ss << _T("Assertion \"") _T(#COND) _T("\" failed: ") \ << __FILE__ << _T(" line ") \ << __LINE__ << _T("."); \ throw ParserError( ecINTERNAL_ERROR, -1, ss.str()); \ }
